steps.title: Order can disappear while correlations remain
Read the sign, not just the magnitude
An interaction has a spatial and spin structure
Area depends on what is plotted
Stripes choose both position and direction
Pair phase is a different coupling
Distort shape without adding a density period
Treat it as an existence mechanism
The Ising label is an orientation
A field can expose or impose an axis
Start with two complex stripe fields
Intensity can still choose an axis
A dimer and an ordered antiferromagnet differ
Put a spinless defect in the correlated plane
Read the nucleus as a local sensor
A scale bends a Curie response
Move from analogy to a test

limits: All new drawings are teaching schematics or labeled toy calculations, not measurements or reconstructed source simulations.
Equal two-site form factor derived from the assumed geometry; Moriya supplies the dynamical weighting framework, not that nuclear geometry calculation.
Triangular-DOS entropy uses a fixed chemical potential and kB=1 teaching units; it is not a calorimetric fit.
Critical fan uses z=nu=1 teaching scaling, not the exponent of every material or the source dimer model.
Schematic damping linewidths and hysteresis branches do not calculate source mode spectra or experimental time.
